dedupe_keys.name: bus network and occupation survey in johannesburg

description: Bus Network and Occupation Survey in Johannesburg is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Thembani Moyo, Alain Kibangou (University of Johannesburg). This dataset represents a subnetwork of public transportation in the city of Johannesburg. It contains counting of bus occupation of three significant routes as well as GPS location of Bus stations. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
